description: This Java class named DriverFactory manages the creation, configuration, retrieval, and quitting of WebDriver instances for different browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Edge). It is designed for use in UI automation tests, providing mechanisms to run browsers headless or headed, handle browser binary paths, and manage driver lifecycle for parallel execution.

classes.name: DriverFactory
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to create, access, and dispose of WebDriver instances for UI automation tests.

methods.name: getDriver
methods.description: Returns the current ThreadLocal WebDriver instance; throws an exception if not initialized.

methods.name: createDriver
methods.description: Initializes a new WebDriver instance based on the specified browser configuration and stores it in ThreadLocal storage.

methods.name: quitDriver
methods.description: Quits the WebDriver instance for the current thread and removes it from ThreadLocal storage.

methods.name: resolveChromeBinaryPath
methods.description: Attempts to find the Chrome binary path from configuration or common default locations.

methods.name: validateExecutable
methods.description: Checks if a given file path points to an existing, executable file.

methods.name: isNoDisplayAvailable
methods.description: Detects if no graphical display environment (like DISPLAY or WAYLAND) is available.
